1168-1418-1651-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1418-1651-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1418-1651-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

851-2793-3743-5089-8242.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
851-2793-3743-5089-8242.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Songbird by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

240-5223-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-5402-7753.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

2963-5153-7150.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
2963-5153-7150.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Teleportation Circle's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Teleportation Circle's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

4613-4742-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-4742-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4742-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

4862-7181.description:
Cast Mirrorform by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each nonland permanent you control to become a copy of Omnath.
Put all nonland permanents besides Omnath into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Omnath triggers for each Omnath that died. Resolve all triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target for each trigger.
4862-7181.notes: The amount of total damage that will be dealt is equal to 3*X*(X-1), where X is the number of nonland permanents you control (including Omnath) as you perform the combo. For example, if you control seven nonland permanents, you will deal 3*7*6 or 126 total damage.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1127-3152-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
1127-3152-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Brigid
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

643-3951-5703-7122.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2511-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

474-803-2034-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {C}{C}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

483-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
483-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

647-3204-4251-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
647-3204-4251-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

372-1018-3556.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

5158-5779.description:
All creatures your opponents control will have base toughness 0, and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness unless there is another effect increasing its toughness.
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control, it will have base toughness 0, and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness unless there is another effect increasing its toughness.

338-2060-2558-3490-3910.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-2060-2558-3490-3910.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
338-2060-2558-3490-3910.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek and another artifact, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.

4050-5003-5359.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk, adding {1}.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Threefold Thunderhulk from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Gnomes, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1558-4711.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
You control a number of nonlegendary artifact creatures that do not have summoning sickness equal to five divided by the number of opponents you have minus one, rounded up.
Opponents cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1558-4711.description:
Declare any number of nonlegendary artifact creatures as attackers.
Each creature's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of each creature attacking each other opponent.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1740-2281-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Extraction Specialist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Extraction Specialist, adding one mana of any color.
When Extraction Specialist dies, Saffi triggers, returning Extraction Specialist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Extraction Specialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

372-2902-4344.description:
Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Journey to Nowhere to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Journey to Nowhere and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Lumbering Battlement to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2452-3651-4311.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aphetto Vulture, adding {C}{C}.
Aphetto Vulture dies, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Aphetto Vulture from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1068-3096.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability, winning the game.

1348-1606.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1348-1606.description:
Declare Ley Weaver as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and any land that can tap to produce at least {1}.
Activate the additional land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

3284-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Mortuary and Korvold trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and drawing Blood Pet from your library.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.
